name: Push-button water bottle
summary: Pressing a button on the front pops the lid open for drinking, the lid clicks shut again, and the whole top unscrews to refill.

parts.name: Bottle body
parts.role: The clear plastic bottle that holds the drink.

parts.name: Screw top
parts.role: The collar with the drinking spout that screws onto the body.

parts.name: Flip lid
parts.role: The hinged cover over the spout that springs open.

parts.name: Release button
parts.role: The button on the front that lets the lid go.

parts.name: Gasket
parts.role: A soft ring inside the top.
